chats.answer:
My pick is the EcoFlow DELTA 3 Max Plus if you need a genuine 3,000W continuous AC output. For home-outage backup, though, I’d spend a little more on a station with a 3,072Wh battery: it stores 50% more energy than the EcoFlow’s 2,048Wh, which matters more than extra output watts once your appliances can start.

I’m assuming you mean at least 3,000W of continuous output, not 3,000Wh of battery capacity, and that you’re shopping in the U.S.

EcoFlow DELTA 3 Max Plus 3000 Watts Portable Power Station

$1,199.00

Lowe's

Best exact-3,000W pick. 2,048Wh LFP battery, expandable capacity, and fast charging. The tradeoff is runtime: roughly 35 minutes at a full 3,000W load, assuming 85% usable energy. 
RV Gear Lab

EcoFlow DELTA 3 Ultra Portable Power Station

$1,369.00

B&H Photo

Best home-backup value at these listed prices. You get 3,600W output and 3,072Wh capacity for a relatively small price increase—about 52 minutes at a 3,000W load under the same assumption.

Anker SOLIX F3000 Portable Power Station

$1,499.99

Micro Center

Best for an RV or solar-heavy setup. 3,600W output, 3,072Wh battery, TT-30 RV outlet, and up to 2,400W solar input. Its major drawback is the 91.5 lb weight, despite having wheels. 
Anker SOLIX US

Before buying: check your appliance’s startup surge and the rating of the individual outlet you’ll use; a station’s total output isn’t necessarily available from one household socket. These are spec- and price-based recommendations, not my own load tests, and Black Friday checkout prices may differ from the listings above.
